entries.title: Revelation of John 10:1
segments: Between the sixth and the seventh trumpet come the visions of the 'little book' and the 'two witnesses.' They relieve the pictures of deserved judgment by telling of revelations of truth and hopes of victory.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:2
segments:
His right foot, etc.  Emblematic of power over land and sea.
 

 
 Little book open. Unsealed and also open; its contents may now be made known; the seer heard them announced as thunder; but he may not tell them yet.  Still, he does announce that God will not longer delay his word.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:7
segments: Mystery of God. The revelation of the truth of the gospel.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:8
segments: Take the book. The volume is now given to the chosen man, and he is to be sent to prophesy (proclaim) from it as it becomes a part of himself.

entries.title: Revelation of John 10:9
segments: Eat it up, etc.  The reception of the revelation would bring joy, but the sorrows predicted therein would bring grief to a sympathetic heart.
